learning_outcomes.text: Model entities and relationships and configure a DbContext
Query data with LINQ using tracking and no-tracking semantics
Save changes, understand change tracking and handle concurrency
Create, apply and manage schema migrations
Diagnose and tune EF Core query performance

integrative_case: Build the data layer for an orders service with EF Core: model customers, orders and line items; query orders with eager loading and no-tracking where appropriate; save a multi-entity unit of work with concurrency handling; evolve the schema with a migration; and diagnose one slow query with logging.
